attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited has uploaded the audio recording of the post-earnings conference call held on November 12, 2026. The call discussed the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website at the provided link. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The notice was issued by Company Secretary Nibedita Panda.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has intimated on Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The Board of Directors and Audit Committee reviewed the report on November 11, 2026. The company confirms no deviation in the utilization of Initial Public Offer proceeds from the objects stated in the Prospectus. The IPO size was Rs 1,599.99 million. Net proceeds were revised to Rs 1,453.32 million. Rs 900.95 million has been utilized. Rs 699.04 million remains unutilized and is invested in fixed deposits. There is a delay in implementation relative to the Prospectus estimate for Fiscal 2026. The report was submitted pursuant to SEBI Listing and ICDR Regulations.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Q2 and H1 FY2027 Press Release".
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited filed its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at Rs. 2,765 million, reflecting a 28.8% year-on-year increase. EBITDA was reported at Rs. 34 million with a margin of 1.2%. Profit after tax was negative Rs. 0.2 million. The company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Glottis Logistics SDN. BHD., in Malaysia to expand international freight forwarding services. Ocean freight import contributed 50% of revenue, while ocean freight export accounted for 42%. The company plans to begin container deployment in Q3 FY27 and complete its capital expenditure program during FY27 using IPO proceeds.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited filed an investor presentation regarding un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 2,765 million, representing a 28.8% year-on-year growth. EBITDA for the quarter was Rs. 34 million with a margin of 1.2%. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 5,110 million, showing a 33.5% year-on-year increase. The company incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Glottis Logistics SDN. BHD., in Malaysia. The presentation is available on the company website at https://www.glottislogistics.in/.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited filed a statement with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the utilization of funds raised through its Initial Public Offering on October 3, 2025. The total amount raised was Rs. 15,399.87 Lakhs. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company confirmed there was no deviation or variation in the use of these funds from the objects stated in the prospectus. The Audit Committee reviewed this statement at its meeting held on November 11, 2026, and reported no comments. The monitoring agency is Crisil Ratings Limited. Net proceeds were revised from Rs. 14,520.07 Lakhs to Rs. 14,533.19 Lakhs during the previous quarter due to lower actual issue expenses, which were adjusted against General Corporate Purposes. The filing was signed by Company Secretary Nibedita Panda and Chief Financial Officer Rajasree.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited disclosed an addendum to its inter-corporate loan agreement with wholly owned subsidiary Glottis Inc. The Board of Directors approved the amendment on November 11, 2026. The loan amount is revised to up to US $ 5.00 Lakhs. The interest rate changed from WCDL rates to Borrowing Cost plus 0.50 spread. The loan remains unsecured. The outstanding loan amount is US$ 1,00,000. The loan must be repaid within five years from disbursement. The transaction is at arm's length. The company states the amendment will not adversely impact business operations or financial position. The addendum was executed on November 11, 2026. The original agreement was dated July 03, 2026.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited approved availing unsecured, interest-free loans from Managing Directors Kuttappan Manikandan and Ramkumar Senthilvel. The Board approved this proposal on November 11, 2026. Each director will provide up to Rs. 30.00 Crores. The aggregate loan amount is Rs. 60.00 Crores. Funds will support working capital and general business operations. Loans are available in tranches. Tenure is up to 5 years from disbursement. Repayment is due within 5 years. Extension or prepayment requires mutual agreement. The transaction is a related party transaction. It is not at arm's length due to the interest-free nature. Each director holds 36.68% equity share capital. Actual amounts drawn will be disclosed separately.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited disclosed an amendment to its Inter-Corporate Loan Agreement with wholly owned subsidiary Glottis Inc. The Board approved the addendum on November 11, 2026. The loan amount was revised from up to Rs. 5.00 Crore to up to US $ 5.00 Lakhs. The interest rate changed from WCDL rates to the Highest Borrowing Cost plus 0.50 spread. The loan remains unsecured. The outstanding loan amount is US $ 1,00,000. The loan must be repaid within five years from the initial disbursement date. The transaction is at arm's length. The company states the amendment will not adversely impact business operations or financial position. Details are available on the company website.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board authorized borrowing up to Rs. 30 Crores from Promoter and Managing Director Mr. Kuttappan Manikandan and up to Rs. 30 Crores from Promoter and Managing Director Mr. Ramkumar Senthilvel. The Board also approved an addendum to the loan agreement with Glottis Inc. Revenue from operations was Rs. 27,647.57 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 51,008.53 Lakhs for the half year. Profit before tax stood at Rs. 57.46 Lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 151.61 Lakhs for the half year. The company reported no investor complaints. IPO proceeds of Rs. 15,999.87 Lakhs were raised, with Rs. 5,990.33 Lakhs currently held in temporary fixed deposits.

attchmntText: Glottis Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Glottis Limited will host a post-earnings conference call for investors and analysts on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 12:00 PM IST. The management team participating includes Managing Directors Ramkumar Senthilvel and Kuttappan Manikandan, and Chief Financial Officer Rajasree A.
